description: This file provides functions to fetch user analytics data from API endpoints, including tenant user summaries and active user trends, with helper functions for query normalization.

methods.name: normalizeQuery(params = {})
methods.description: Helper function to convert query parameters, especially date fields, into ISO strings and clean undefined/null/empty values.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: Query parameters object, defaults to empty object.

methods.returns: Normalized query object suitable for API calls.

methods.name: getTenantUsersSummary(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches a summary of tenant users with optional filters like date range and status.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: Optional query parameters for filtering results.

methods.returns: An object containing items array and total count of tenant users.

methods.name: getActiveUsersTrend(params = {})
methods.description: Retrieves time-based trend data for active users, with optional filters.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: Optional query parameters for filtering and scope.

methods.returns: An object with items array and optional meta information.
